subject: Urgent: GreenWave capacity incident - hosted -> dedicated/private decision
messages:
From: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@greenwave.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@greenwave.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Production incident - hitting hosted rate limits (urgent)

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Quick summary from this morning's incident: between 09:30-09:55am PT we started seeing a spike of 5xx and 429 responses from the Redwood hosted API. Our observability shows a burst of inference traffic from our recommendation service that wasn't anticipated and it caused throttling across several endpoints. We had partial degradation for ~20 minutes; user-visible latency increased and some batch jobs failed.

We patched routing on our side to reduce invocation rate and backfill, but this was a close call for our SLA. We need to understand: can Redwood give us guaranteed capacity (dedicated) or is there a private option we can move to quickly? Procurement is asking for costs and an estimated timeline.

Attachments: incident_log.txt (truncated)	6 includes timestamps and request ids.

Can we hop on a quick call today? If Dedicated can be provisioned in <72 hours with an interim mitigation plan, that would be ideal. If not, we need to weigh private VPC or an interim rate limit + circuit-breaker approach.

Also looping in our CTO Tom (cc'd) and procurement for visibility. We have an open deal (GF-4921) with volume expectations that changed after a recent launch.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Kline
Head of Platform, GreenWave, Inc.
[sarah.kline@greenwave.ai]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@greenwave.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production incident - hitting hosted rate limits (urgent)

Thanks for the heads up, Sarah	6 I'm really sorry you hit that. Appreciate the logs, they help.

Immediate items (short answers):
- Mitigation: We can push an emergency routing policy and temporary increased quota for your API key to reduce 429s; I can sign that off today with Laura. This is a short-term mitigation but not capacity-isolation.
- Dedicated: We have an expedited provisioning path for Dedicated pools. Standard lead time is ~1 week, but for incidents we can prioritize and target 48-72 hours if you can sign the commitment + SOW and allow us to provision in the us-west region.
- Private VPC / On-prem: This is doable but typically a longer process (2-4 weeks) because of network, KMS, and SOC2 packaging. Not ideal for a 48-hour fix.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick triage call (30m) today to decide whether to request an emergency quota bump vs. immediate Dedicated provisioning.
2) If Dedicated is preferred: Laura will share a one-page SOW and expedited pricing and DocuSign link; we start provisioning after signed PO.
3) Connor (cc) will prepare a technical runbook for cutover and a minimal config to reduce noise (autoscale limits, routing policy, KV cache pre-warm).

I'm attaching a short checklist we use for hosted->dedicated moves: Hosted-to-Dedicated-Checklist.pdf
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Available today: 12:00pm PT, 2:00pm PT or 4:30pm PT. Which works for you?

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@greenwave.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production incident - hitting hosted rate limits (urgent)

Sarah	6 thanks for the details. We can move fast here. A few specifics to help procurement:

Pricing & timeline (expedited):
- Dedicated reserved capacity (priority provisioning): one-time provisioning + 3-month minimum commitment. Expedited provisioning estimate: 48-72 hours after signed PO/SOW.
- Private VPC (on-prem options available): 2-4 weeks onboarding, requires KMS/HSM setup, network peering, and an enterprise agreement.

Security/compliance: we can provide SOC 2 evidence, audit logs, and a dedicated audit trail for the Dedicated pool. For Private VPC we provide full customer-managed networking and KMS integration.

I've attached a draft SLA and a concise SOW we commonly use for expedited Dedicated moves: SLA_draft.pdf (attached). I'll also send the DocuSign link once you confirm you'd like to proceed with Dedicated.

Questions for you:
- Is data segregation a hard requirement (i.e., must processes be in a VPC/on-prem), or would a dedicated (isolated) pool within our cloud satisfy procurement?
- Do you have an internal security checklist we can run through quickly? If so, please share and Connor will prepare answers.

If you confirm Dedicated and can expedite procurement, we can begin provisioning immediately.

	6Laura
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@greenwave.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@greenwave.ai>, procurement@greenwave.ai
Date: 2026-03-02T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production incident - hitting hosted rate limits (urgent)

Thanks, Marissa/Laura	6 appreciate the quick responses. GreenWave's decision: we want Dedicated capacity ASAP to avoid further customer impact. Procurement has flagged that Dedicated must provide logical data isolation and audit logging; they are not ruling out Private VPC but need a timeline and cost comparison.

Action items on our side:
- Procurement needs the SOW and expedited pricing to sign today (GF-4921).
- Our CISO wants a short architecture deep-dive (30m) to confirm logging & KMS options. Can you arrange that?

We can sign a 3-month commit to get started if Dedicated is available in the 48-72 hour window. If Private VPC proves necessary, we will open that parallel track but prefer to start with Dedicated to get immediate isolation.

Tom: our CTO	6 we may need to coordinate on the landing zone/networking if we go Private.

Sarah
Sarah Kline
Head of Platform, GreenWave, Inc.
[sarah.kline@greenwave.ai]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@greenwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production incident - hitting hosted rate limits (urgent)

Sarah	6 hi, Connor from Solutions here. Quick technical plan and immediate actions below.

Short version: we can provision an expedited Dedicated pool in us-west and route GreenWave traffic there within ~48 hours after signed PO. That will give you isolated GPUs, separate KV cache namespaces, and dedicated autoscaling settings so noisy neighbors won't affect you. If you later decide you need Private VPC/on-prem, we can migrate with minimal downtime but that process takes longer (2-4 weeks).

Immediate mitigation (today):
- Emergency temporary quota bump for your API key (2x) to reduce 429s while we provision Dedicated. Laura can approve billing hold.
- Implement a routing fallback: we’ll route non-critical traffic to a lower-cost model variant to protect core flows.

Expedited Dedicated cutover plan (48-72 hr target):
1) Procurement/PO signed -> we reserve nodes in us-west.
2) Pre-provision KV cache warmup and model weights caching window (we'll coordinate a 1-2 hour pre-warm window).
3) Swap DNS/routing and monitor for 2 hours; rollback plan included.

Attachments: provision_runbook.md, cost_estimate.xlsx
Links: DocuSign for expedited SOW: https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Let me know the best time for the CISO deep-dive (Connor/Marissa/Rishi available tomorrow 10:00am PT or 3:00pm PT). We can scope logging, KMS, and network options and produce the SOC2 artifacts your security team wants.

- Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
